title: Modeling and Analysis of the Measuring Channel Characteristics for Power Quality Assessment – A Review Study
content: The article presents developed and implemented hardware and software applications, according to original concepts related to structures and algorithms, in which the processing characteristics of the measurement system are implemented. Starting from a generous concept regarding the measurement path based on the literature review, the main emphasis of this paper is focused on the configuration of the device for measuring the power quality and validation of the processing characteristics of the tested devices. In the context of the analyzed device, a special attention is paid to the test studies, as well as to the issues of data transfer in the developed device and to the coordination of operation in this device. Some new ideas related to the analyzed issues and original findings are presented, analyzed and commented.
